data.one_liner: Transform point coordinates between different coordinate systems and datums.
data.what_it_does: Proj4dart transforms geographic point coordinates from one coordinate system to another. It supports predefined projections, Proj4 definition strings, OGC and ESRI WKT definitions, and datum transformations.
use_when: You need to convert GPS coordinates between different EPSG codes or coordinate reference systems.
You are working with custom map projections or datum shifts in Dart and Flutter.
avoid_when: You only need simple distance calculations on a flat plane without coordinate system conversions.
strengths: Extensive support for Proj4, OGC WKT, and ESRI WKT definitions.
Thoroughly tested against thousands of standard projection definitions.
weaknesses: Limited to point coordinate transformations rather than full vector geometry rendering.
Grid files for datum shifts must be loaded manually into memory.
